interpretation.summary: Sofia reports that the LT keeps the completed audio review on the same screen after clicking Submit, referencing task AUDIO-1172. Bea adds that the page does not show a submitted confirmation after selecting option B. Leo inquires whether any required rating fields are unset or if the submit control is disabled after completing them.
